facts.fact: Rex 走远后，Mrs. Malstow 朝同一方向动身，并确保 Olivia 紧挨着她走。
facts.anchor: When he was out of sight, Mrs. Malstow started off in the same direction, making sure I was beside her.

facts.fact: Mrs. Malstow 用一个僵硬的手势指向有绿色呢门的凹室；门后是走廊与另一道楼梯，即仆役通道。
facts.anchor: She made a stiff gesture with her hand indicating an alcove with a green baize door.

facts.fact: 走廊上一扇门打开，一名年轻男仆端着一托盘空杯子出来。
facts.anchor: A door in the hallway opened and a young man emerged carrying a tray of empty glasses.

facts.fact: 男仆称这些空杯来自 Lord Garrus 套房的深夜饮酒；看见 Olivia 后，Mrs. Malstow 微微摇头制止他再说。
facts.anchor: Late night in Lord Garrus’s suite.

facts.fact: 这是 Olivia 由管家的摇头作出的推断：女客确实有时会摸进 Rex 的住处。
facts.anchor: So guests did sometimes find their way into Rex’s quarters. Women guests.

facts.fact: Mrs. Malstow 在嘉宾名单上见过 Tamsin（Miss Griggs）与 Olivia 的名字，并当面把两人称作 Simon Dunnent 带来的不速之客。
facts.anchor: It was generous of Mr. de Voil to allow Mr. Dunnent to bring two uninvited guests.

facts.fact: Mrs. Malstow 身上的香水名叫 My Sin；Olivia 在父亲招待的一位伦敦女演员身上闻过同一支香。
facts.anchor: My Sin, the perfume was called.

facts.fact: 分手前 Mrs. Malstow 捏住 Olivia 的肘部，点名 Madden 小姐，说这里有人会迷路，姑娘们会迷路。
facts.anchor: “People lose their way here, Miss Madden. Girls lose their way.”
